niche_preference_profile: This user prefers clean, polished, app-like interfaces that feel complete and well-organized. They like light or airy backgrounds in many contexts, but also respond well to dark, focused modal dialogs when the layout is minimal and uncluttered. Across screens, they strongly favor visible content, clear sectioning, balanced spacing, and explicit labels over sparse, empty, or placeholder-like layouts. They also prefer concise, direct copy and clear primary actions, with a noticeable bias toward blue CTAs and calm, reassuring presentation in alerts.

criteria.description: Prefers screens that show more of the expected settings, entries, or options rather than sparse or incomplete states.
Prefers interfaces divided into clearly labeled sections or grouped cards, with strong organizational boundaries.
Prefers layouts that feel evenly filled and purposeful, avoiding large empty areas, unfinished rows, or awkward whitespace.
Prefers screens that feel finished, intentional, modern, and refined rather than placeholder-like, dated, or underdeveloped.
Prefers specific, descriptive labels and strong title/section hierarchy that make the screen easy to scan and understand.
Prefers concise, direct explanatory text over verbose, instructional, or marketing-like copy.
Prefers obvious, high-contrast primary actions, especially blue CTAs, that stand out clearly from the rest of the UI.
